claims.statement: A New York dispatch of May 14, 1871 reported that Tom Allen offered to fight Joe Coburn for $5,000 (printed as $5020) or Ned O'Baldwin for $1,000 a side.
claims.excerpt: Tem Allen also offers to fight Coburn for $5020, or

notes: Telegraph report; Allen later denied it (see 433). The offer is one side's report.
